title.vi: Word Objective 1.2 — Định dạng tài liệu

prompt.vi: Đặt màu nền trang (Page Color) thành xám nhạt DFDBD5.
prompt.en: Set the page color to the light grey DFDBD5.

fail.en: Page Color DFDBD5 was not found.

unverified.vi: Chưa đọc được màu nền trang.
unverified.en: The page color could not be read.

error.vi: Không đọc được phần nền trang.
error.en: The page background could not be read.

help_steps.en: Open the **Design** tab.
In the **Page Background** group, click **Page Color**.
Choose the light grey (Theme **Background 2** / DFDBD5).

prompt.en: Insert a text watermark that reads Example Only.

pass.vi: Watermark Example Only đã có trên trang.
pass.en: The Example Only watermark is present.

fail.en: The Example Only watermark was not found.

unverified.en: The watermark could not be read.

error.en: The watermark header could not be read.

help_steps.en: On the **Design** tab, in the **Page Background** group.
Click **Watermark** > **Custom Watermark**.
Select **Text watermark**, type **Example Only**, then click **OK**.

prompt.vi: Thêm đường viền trang (Page Borders) nét đơn.
prompt.en: Add a single-line page border to the document.

unverified.en: The page border could not be read.

error.en: The section properties could not be read.

help_steps.en: On the **Design** tab, in the **Page Background** group.
Click **Page Borders**.

help_steps.vi: Setting **Box**, Style nét đơn, **Apply to: Whole document**, **OK**.
help_steps.en: Choose Setting **Box**, a single-line Style, **Apply to: Whole document**, then **OK**.

prompt.vi: Thêm header có tiêu đề tài liệu.
prompt.en: Insert a header that contains the document title.

pass.en: The header contains the document title.

fail.vi: Header chưa có trường Title / Document title.
fail.en: The header does not contain a Title / Document Title field.

unverified.en: The header could not be read.

error.en: The header could not be read.

help_steps.en: On the **Insert** tab, in the **Header & Footer** group, click **Header**.
Choose a built-in header that includes **Document Title**.
Click **Close Header and Footer**.

prompt.vi: Thêm số trang (trường PAGE) trong header.
prompt.en: Add a page number (PAGE field) to the header.

pass.en: The header contains a PAGE field.

fail.vi: Chưa thấy số trang trong header.
fail.en: No page number was found in the header.

unverified.en: The PAGE field could not be read.

error.en: The header could not be read.

help_steps.en: Double-click the **Header** area.
On the **Header & Footer** tab, click **Page Number**.

help_steps.vi: Chọn vị trí trên trang, rồi đóng header.
help_steps.en: Choose a position on the page, then close the header.

prompt.vi: Bật Different First Page cho header/footer.
prompt.en: Turn on Different First Page for the header and footer.

pass.vi: Đã bật Different First Page kèm header.
pass.en: Different First Page is on and a header is present.

fail.vi: Chưa bật Different First Page hoặc chưa có header.
fail.en: Different First Page is off, or there is no header.

unverified.en: The first-page setting could not be read.

error.en: The section properties could not be read.

help_steps.en: Double-click the **Header**.
On the **Header & Footer** tab, select **Different First Page**.

help_steps.vi: Để trang đầu trống hoặc chỉ watermark; số trang từ trang 2.
help_steps.en: Leave the first page blank (or watermark only); numbering starts on page 2.

prompt.vi: Áp một Style Set sao cho Heading 1 có cỡ 15 pt.
prompt.en: Apply a style set so that Heading 1 is 15 pt.

pass.vi: Heading 1 đã đổi cỡ theo style set.
pass.en: Heading 1 changed size with the style set.

fail.vi: Heading 1 chưa ở cỡ 15 pt — hãy áp một Style Set trên tab Design.
fail.en: Heading 1 is not 15 pt — apply a Style Set on the Design tab.

unverified.en: The style definitions could not be read.

error.en: The style could not be read.

help_steps.en: On the **Design** tab, in the **Document Formatting** group.
Open the **Style Sets** gallery.

help_steps.vi: Chọn một bộ (ví dụ **Casual**) rồi xem **Heading 1** đổi cỡ.
help_steps.en: Choose a set (for example **Casual**) and check that **Heading 1** changes size.
